info.name: MulkMed Local MajorOrganTest & Senoclock APIs
info.description: Postman collection to test MajorOrganTest and SenoClock integrations locally.

formdata.description: Upload a PDF or image report file here

request.description: Uploads a lab report PDF/image to extract biomarkers and trigger background Senoclock integration.

item.name: Major Organ Test - Generate Senoclock Report

request.description: Downloads the generated Senoclock PDF report for a given lab_report_id or senoclock_id. If not generated yet, it will generate it synchronously.
